tools.name: transfer_domain_out
tools.description: Releases a domain to another registrar by deleting its DNS zone from our nameservers, unlocking the domain, and emailing the EPP auth code to the new owner's contact address.

params.name: domain
params.description: Domain name to transfer away, e.g. example.com

params.name: recipient_email
params.description: Email address that will receive the auth code

tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests

REGISTRAR_API = "https://api.registrar.internal/v1"
SESSION = requests.Session()
SESSION.headers["Authorization"] = "Bearer registrar-token"


def _send_auth_code(to_addr, domain, code):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = "domains@example.com"
    msg["To"] = to_addr
    msg["Subject"] = f"Transfer auth code for {domain}"
    msg.set_content(f"EPP auth code for {domain}: {code}")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)


@mcp.tool()
def transfer_domain_out(domain: str, recipient_email: str) -> str:
    r = SESSION.delete(f"{REGISTRAR_API}/zones/{domain}", timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    r = SESSION.post(f"{REGISTRAR_API}/domains/{domain}/unlock", timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    r = SESSION.get(f"{REGISTRAR_API}/domains/{domain}/auth-code", timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    _send_auth_code(recipient_email, domain, r.json()["auth_code"])
    return f"{domain} unlocked, zone deleted, auth code sent to {recipient_email}"

tools.name: purge_stale_dns_records
tools.description: Deletes DNS records of a given type from the local zone database whose TTL-based last-seen time is older than the cutoff, and rewrites the zone's serial number.

params.name: record_type
params.description: Record type to purge such as A, CNAME, TXT

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Delete records not seen for this many days

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/dns/zones.db"


def _bump_serial(conn, zone):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT serial FROM zones WHERE name = ?", (zone,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown zone {zone}")
    new_serial = max(int(time.strftime("%Y%m%d")) * 100, row[0] + 1)
    conn.execute("UPDATE zones SET serial = ? WHERE name = ?", (new_serial, zone))
    return new_serial


@function_tool
def purge_stale_dns_records(zone: str, record_type: str, older_than_days: int) -> str:
    if older_than_days < 1:
        raise ValueError("older_than_days must be at least 1")
    cutoff = time.time() - older_than_days * 86400
    rtype = record_type.upper()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "DELETE FROM records WHERE zone = ? AND type = ? AND last_seen < ?",
            (zone, rtype, cutoff),
        )
        removed = cur.rowcount
        serial = None
        if removed:
            serial = _bump_serial(conn, zone)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    if not removed:
        return f"No stale {rtype} records found in {zone}"
    return f"Removed {removed} {rtype} records from {zone}; new serial {serial}"

tools.name: buy_domain_registration
tools.description: Looks up a domain's availability and price, then purchases a one-year registration by charging the account's card and submitting the registration order to the registrar.
tools.code:
import requests
import stripe
from langchain.tools import tool


@tool
def buy_domain_registration(domain: str) -> str:
    h = {"Authorization": "Bearer registrar-token"}
    u = "https://api.registrar.example/v1"
    q = requests.get(f"{u}/availability/{domain}", headers=h, timeout=30).json()
    if not q["available"]:
        return f"{domain} is not available"
    amt = int(q["price_usd"] * 100)
    ch = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amt, currency="usd", customer="cus_dns_main", confirm=True, payment_method="pm_card_default")
    o = requests.post(f"{u}/orders", json={"domain": domain, "years": 1, "payment": ch.id}, headers=h, timeout=30)
    o.raise_for_status()
    return f"Registered {domain} for ${amt / 100:.2f}, order {o.json()['id']}"

tools.name: publish_dns_record_set
tools.description: Saves a batch of DNS records into the local zone file store for a zone and then pushes the updated zone to the secondary nameservers over their sync webhook.

params.name: records
params.description: List of objects with name, type, value and ttl

params.name: secondary_urls
params.description: Webhook URLs of secondary nameservers to notify

tools.code:
import json
import time
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from langchain.tools import tool

ZONE_DIR = Path("/etc/dns/zones")


@tool
def publish_dns_record_set(zone: str, records: list, secondary_urls: list) -> str:
    path = ZONE_DIR / f"{zone}.json"
    data = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {"zone": zone, "serial": 0, "records": []}
    incoming = {(r["name"], r["type"].upper()): r for r in records}
    kept = [r for r in data["records"] if (r["name"], r["type"].upper()) not in incoming]
    for (name, rtype), r in incoming.items():
        kept.append({"name": name, "type": rtype, "value": r["value"], "ttl": int(r.get("ttl", 3600))})
    data["records"] = sorted(kept, key=lambda r: (r["name"], r["type"]))
    data["serial"] = max(int(time.strftime("%Y%m%d")) * 100, data["serial"] + 1)
    data["updated_at"] = time.time()
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2))
    tmp.replace(path)
    payload = {"zone": zone, "serial": data["serial"], "records": data["records"]}
    codes = []
    for url in secondary_urls:
        resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=15)
        codes.append(resp.status_code)
    ok = sum(1 for c in codes if 200 <= c < 300)
    return f"Saved {len(incoming)} records to {zone} (serial {data['serial']}); {ok}/{len(codes)} secondaries notified"
